site.context: Spanish Mediterranean SWRO reject (Villar et al. 2023 Table 2 Mediterranean Sea column); Almería / Carboneras-coast regional screening, not an Almería intake sample, not Alboran seawater feed

meta.quality: Majors cited from Villar et al. 2023 Desalination Table 2 Mediterranean Sea reject column (Cl, Na, SO4, Mg, Ca, K, Li) as kg/m³. HCO3 0.273 kg/m³ omitted (not in SUBSTANCES). Br not pinned in the extracted table — omitted. Not a Carboneras plant sample.
meta.notes: Ion masses converted from tabulated kg/m³ (= g/L) to g/kg with density 1.054 kg/L (screening from ~72 g/L ion-sum band — not a CTD). mol_per_kg = g_per_kg / molarMassG from engine/model SUBSTANCES. Literature numbers are preferred over forcing charge balance. salinity_g_per_kg is the summed cited majors. Spanish Mediterranean SWRO reject is not a mineral concession and is not Alboran Millero seawater.
